cell_type.evidence: Through a targeted drug screen, we found the recently approved multi-kinase inhibitor midostaurin to have potent activity in several lung cancer cells independent of its intended target, PKC, or a specific genomic marker.

material_type.evidence: inferred: Cells were lysed with urea lysis buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 8, 9 M urea, 1 mM sodium orthovanadate, 2.5 mM sodium pyrophosphate, 1 mM β-glycerophosphate), sonicated using a microtip sonicator at 15 W with 3 bursts of 15 seconds each, digested and purified using the Cell Signaling Sep-Pak C18 peptide purification protocol (Cell Signaling Technology).
